# United Nations

> > The official website of the United Nations, the international organization working on peace, security, sustainable development, human rights, and humanitarian affairs worldwide.

The UN coordinates global efforts through its member states, specialized agencies, and country offices to address challenges including the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), peacekeeping operations, human rights protection, and gender equality. The organization provides research resources, training materials, and procurement information to support its mission.

## Key Topics

- United Nations
- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Agenda 2030
- Human Rights
- Gender Equality
- Peacekeeping Operations
- Security Council
- UN Country Teams
- Multilateral Development
- International Women's Day
- Public Health
- Transparency and Accountability
- Development Finance
- UN Women
- UNESCO

## Country Presence & Programs

- [Naciones Unidas en Bolivia](https://bolivia.un.org/es?rsd): UN Bolivia homepage covering SDGs, human rights, and gender equality

## Research & Reference

- [Vetoes - UN Security Council Meetings & Outcomes Tables](https://research.un.org/en/docs/sc/quick): Security Council vetoes reference guide at Dag Hammarskjöld Library

## Peacekeeping & Training

- [Training - Peacekeeping Resource Hub](https://peacekeepingresourcehub.un.org/en/training): DPO peacekeeping training resources for civilian and uniformed personnel

## Optional

- [UN Development Business Phase Down](https://devbusiness.un.org/): UNDB service closure notice for procurement opportunities platform
